Praying To Modify The Judgment And Award Dated
14.07.2014, Passed By The Iii Addl. District Judge
At Gulbarga In Lac Appeal No.397/2013, Vide
Annexure-A And Pleased To Modify By Allowing
The Appeal By Enhancing The Compensation At
Rs.1,73,780/- Per Acre Dry Land From Rs.88,320/-
Per Acre As Awarded By The Lower Appellate
Court, And Prayed To Award More By Permitting
To Pay Dcf In The Event Of Disposal, With All
Statutory Benefits.

This Appeal, Coming On For Orders, This Day,
Judgment Was Delivered Therein As Under:
Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Ravi V Hosmani
 Oral Judgment
(PER: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE RAVI V HOSMANI) Challenging judgment and award dated 14.07.2014 passed by III Additional District Judge, Gulbarga in LACA no.397/2013, this appeal is filed.
2. Sri S.S.Sajjanshetty, learned counsel for appellant submitted that appellant is land loser-claimant seeking for further enhancement of compensation.

It was submitted that land bearing Sy.No.97/2 measuring 13 NC: 2025:KHC-K:2860 HC-KAR acres 32 guntas situated at Venkatabennur belonging to claimant was acquired for purpose of construction of Khaja Kotnoor watertank under preliminary notification dated 08.11.1990.
It was submitted that as per award passed by SLAO on 27.10.1992 market value was fixed at `8,000/- per acre.
Not satisfied with same, appellant had sought reference.

Reference Court in LAC no.302/1995 had determined market value as `20,000/-
Kupendra vs The Special Land Acquisition Officer ... on 5 June, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/135442104/
2 per acre.
Not satisfied with same he had preferred appeal in LACA no.397/2013.
Though appeal was allowed and there was enhancement to `88,320/- per acre, claimant was not satisfied with same.
Hence, present appeal is filed.

3. It was submitted in respect of same project under same preliminary notification lands belonging to same village, i.e., Sy.No.97(A) and (C) of Venkatbennur village, this Court in MSA no.200226/2018 disposed off on 28.03.2025 had determined market value at `1,43,863/- per acre.
Said judgment would squarely cover subject matter and seeks for allowing of appeal.
NC: 2025:KHC-K:2860 HC-KAR 4.

Dr.Archana P.Tiwari, learned Additional Advocate General appearing for Sri Maqbool Ahmed,
learned Additional Government Advocate for respondents fairly concedes about matter being covered.
5. In view of above, appeal would requires to be allowed.
Ordered accordingly.
Appeal is allowed with costs.
The claimant is held entitled for compensation at rate of `1,43,863/- per acre along with statutory benefits and interest.

It is clarified that claimant would not be entitled for interest for total period of 2450 days being delay in filing appeal as well as delay in filing application for recalling (as per order dated 16.04.2025).

Sd/-
(RAVI V HOSMANI) JUDGE SN CT:SI Kupendra vs The Special Land Acquisition Officer ... on 5 June, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/135442104/
